name: shared-computations
$tagsComment: Tier 3 of docs/business-apps/architecture.md: the runtime of layout version 2's computed fields, one of the engines section 14 lists. The first scope:engine project. An engine carries scope:shared as well, because it lives in libs/shared/ and shared code may use it. Plain TypeScript with no Angular and no HTTP, so it depends on the app definition's contract only.

test.$inputsComment: nx.json's test inputs, plus the layout version 2 proposal, whose examples' computations must evaluate. Without it an edit to the proposal would replay a cached pass. Not SATORI_TEST_TZ: vite.config.mts runs the suite in two zones of its own, which are project files. The signatures the contract test holds the evaluators to come in through ^production.

typecheck.$comment: Plain TypeScript, so tsc rather than ngc. The spec files are type-checked by the spec-types gate through tsconfig.spec.json.
